zimbabwe.title: Flag of the Republic of Zimbabwe

colors.note: Represents the nation's agriculture and rural land.
Symbolises the country's abundant mineral wealth.
Represents the blood shed during the liberation struggle.
Represents the heritage and ethnicity of the Black majority population.
The white triangle and emblem stand for peace.

desc:
- Seven horizontal stripes of green, yellow, red, black, red, yellow, and green
- A white triangle at the hoist bears a red five-pointed star and the golden Great Zimbabwe bird
- Adopted on 18 April 1980 at independence from the United Kingdom, replacing the Rhodesian flag
trivia:
- The golden bird is the Great Zimbabwe bird, a soapstone sculpture found at the medieval Great Zimbabwe ruins
- The red star represents the revolutionary aspirations of the ZANU-PF liberation movement
- Zimbabwe's flag replaced the green-white-green banner of Rhodesia flown under white-minority rule
- The colour scheme draws on the flag of the ZANU (Patriotic Front), which led the liberation war
